records.context: one row per cell with any read: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (exact or corrected), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (distinct callable barcodes), ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` and ``level`` of the top barcode (empty unless ``perfect`` or ``great``), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (of matched reads), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` and ``quality``. With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.

Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.
records.translation: 리드가 하나라도 있는 세포마다 한 행: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched``(정확 또는 보정), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes``(서로 다른 호출 가능 바코드), 최상위 바코드의 ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene``, ``level``(``perfect`` 또는 ``great``가 아니면 빈 값), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share``(매칭된 리드 중 비율), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read``, ``quality``. ``minority_min_reads``가 2 이상이면 ``barcodes``, ``second_reads``, 등급은 규칙이 남긴 리드만 세며, 두 열이 추가됩니다: ``minority_ignored``(제외된 리드)와 ``minority_rescued``(규칙 덕분에만 세포가 호출되면 True). ``'weighted_majority'``(:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`)에서는 가중치가 가장 큰 바코드가 최상위 바코드이며, 다섯 열이 추가됩니다. ``weight_top``과 ``weight_total``은 최상위 바코드와 세포의 리드 가중치 합입니다. ``d_weight_top``은 최상위 바코드 리드의 거리 항 합이고, ``g_median_top``은 그 리드들의 핵 거리 중앙값입니다(핵이 없으면 NaN). ``bleed_discounted``는 이웃 할인으로 가중치가 낮아진 바코드 수를 셉니다.
